articles.title: Smoke from giant fires is choking the air — here’s a cool trick to clean it!
articles.summary: Huge wildfires in Canada and Minnesota are sending thick smoke across the U.S., making the air dangerous to breathe. You can build a simple air purifier with a box fan, a filter, and duct tape.

articles.title: China’s president says AI should be a team sport, not a solo race
articles.summary: At a big AI conference in Shanghai, China’s leader Xi Jinping said no single country should control artificial intelligence. He announced plans to share AI tools and training with 30 developing nations.

articles.title: Meet the UK’s next prime minister: Andy Burnham is getting ready to lead
articles.summary: Andy Burnham will become the UK’s new prime minister on Monday. He’s still picking his top team and says fixing social care for older and disabled people will be a big priority.
